result.final: Cheapest seller where the Wexcombe tee in size M can actually be ordered: Haldane Apparel (http://localhost:7770/igr-tcl-40.html), price $11.92 for size M. M was selected in the size menu, the page showed $11.92 with M chosen, and Add to Cart was enabled (orderable), even though the menu label carried stock text 'M - Only 1 left!'. Progress: opened 5 listings in ascending advertised-price order — Dovercourt Apparel ($10.13, no M option at all — cannot order M), Whitlock Outfitters ($11.09, M option present but disabled), Carnforth Textile Company ($11.38, M enabled, price $13.02 — first candidate best), Oakfield Textile Company ($11.69, M disabled), Haldane Apparel ($11.92, M enabled, price $11.92 — new best). Skipped 40 listings (Dalston Textiles $12.85 through Garrick Apparel $39.23) because their advertised price (the cheapest buyable option in each listing) was already at or above the best M total found ($11.92), so none could beat Haldane; this made skipping safe under the given bound rule. Stopped when no unopened listing had an advertised price below the best total ($11.92).
